newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures rally late to close mostly up.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures rally late to close mostly up.

text.p: CME lumber futures rallied late to end mixed with nearbys higher, with September pacing the gain on strong cash markets, traders said.

Despite pressure from a sharply lower bond market and early rolling of long positions out of September ahead of its limitless spot position Tuesday, late support was evident, linked to continued strength in cash. Mills have continued to lift asking prices and there is demand for September deliveries, they said.
Random Lengths quoted cash spruce at $422 per tbf, up $3 from midweek and up $8 from last Friday.
Lumber closed $1.90 per tbf higher to $8.10 lower with only lightly traded distant March and May lower. September was up most at $414.20 and November ended up $0.80 at $368.30.
